# Implementation Plan: crews proactive-done silent-miss regression (reviewed-cursor over-advance without expand)

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-09. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <job_dir>/plan.md`.*

## Overview

A crews proactive-batch **terminal** report (`kind=done|question|blocked`) routed to the
lead can be consumed-and-cursor-advanced such that the lead's later `/crews:review-mail`
returns `{entries:[], advanced:false, lastReviewedSeq:501}` — the lead silently misses the
report (repro 2026-06-08 / crews 3.14.1, member `bs-serverless`, lead `mailbox-history` seq
501, message `"bs-serverless done (proactive batch, 6 reports)"`). This is a **regression** of
the bug class originally fixed in crews **v3.6.2**, but with a *different* root cause: v3.6.2
fixed an orphan/duplicate-listener *consume* race (the `lastListenerEpoch` fence —
`mailbox.js:660-687`, intact and unrelated here). The v3.14.1 recurrence is a **reviewed-cursor
(`lastReviewedSeq`) over-advance** bug enabled by the protocol-v2 per-report-outbox change.

**Root-cause family.** A cursor-advancing read/consume path advances `lastReviewedSeq` past a
delivered, review-required, protocol-v2 proactive **terminal** row *without surfacing it as an
expanded, structurally-reviewable entry*. The protocol-v2 commit `af07987d` made the terminal
content live inside `payload.entries[]` and taught **only `review-mail`** to expand it
(`expandReviewRows`, review-mail.js:154-169,239); the other cursor-advancing paths were left
formatting/advancing on the un-expanded batch row. Candidate over-advance paths (all confirmed
present on current main, v3.19.0):

1. **`/wake`** (`hooks/user-prompt-submit.js:75-92`) — consumes, formats **raw** history rows
   via `formatReviewMailEntry` (line 79, NO `expandReviewRows`), then `markReviewed(reviewedSeq =
   lastReviewRequiredSeq)` (lines 85-88) — advances `lastReviewedSeq` without expanding the
   buried per-report `done`. (`/wake` gained `markReviewed` in `9347c0c0` *before* protocol v2;
   `af07987d` then added expansion to review-mail only — the parity gap.)
2. **`review-mail --since N`** (`hooks/commands/review-mail.js:226-230` vs `268-272`) — displays
   only rows with `seq > args.since` but advances `reviewedSeq` to `max(allRows.seq)` (which
   includes the suppressed terminal row). Pinned by `tests/review-mail-command.test.js:188-191`
   (intended explicit-skip semantics, but still an advance-past-unsurfaced-row surface).
3. **`review-mail` legacy-cursor recovery branch** (`review-mail.js:274-291`) — advances
   `lastReviewedSeq` to `lastReviewRequiredSeq` when `allRows.length === 0 &&
   lastReviewRequiredSeq > lastReviewedSeq`. If `consumeMailbox` stamps a proactive batch
   review-required (`mailbox.js:701`) but `review-mail`'s `filterReviewRequired` drops it (env
   `CREWS_REVIEW_KINDS` drift / predicate divergence), this silently advances past it.

**Important nuance (do not over-claim `/wake`).** The bookkeeper repro says the **armed
listener** delivered the batch "via watch". The listener `deliver()` → `consumeMailbox`
(`lib/listener-loop.js:444-487`) does NOT advance `lastReviewedSeq`, and a Phase-2 codex live
repro showed the listener+`review-mail` path WORKS (3 entries, `advanced:true`). So `/wake`
alone does **not** explain a pure listener-delivery incident: if the listener consumed the
batch, a later `/wake` finds an empty mailbox and never calls `markReviewed`
(`user-prompt-submit.js:77-94`). Therefore the FIRST story **reproduces and instruments** the
seq-501 symptom to pin which advancer(s) actually fire; the fix then closes ALL confirmed
cursor-advance-without-expanded-surface paths so the incident is repaired regardless of which
one the bookkeeper hit. The metadata-only listener contract is preserved (no v3.6.2
double-notify).

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
- `hooks/commands/review-mail.js:154-169` — `expandReviewRows(row)`: pure, **module-local
  (not exported)** helper mapping `payload.entries[]` → per-report display rows (carrying
  `inboxSeq`, `outboxSeq`, `reportId`/`outboxId`, `consumedAt`, per-entry `kind`/`summary`).
  Used at `review-mail.js:239` (`rows.flatMap(row => expandReviewRows(row))`); cursor advance
  uses `allRows` not `displayRows` (lines 268-272).
- `hooks/user-prompt-submit.js:70-92` — `/wake`: `consumeMailbox(..., 'wake', ...)`, then
  `historyRows.map(formatReviewMailEntry)` (line 79, NO expand), then `markReviewed` (85-88).
  `formatReviewMailEntry` imported from `./commands/review-mail` (line 12); `markReviewed`
  from `./actors`. `wake-explicit-only` gate: only `/wake` consumes (lines 67-69).
- `hooks/mailbox.js:635-722` — `consumeMailbox`: drains `mailbox.json` → `mailbox-history.jsonl`,
  stamps `lastReviewRequiredSeq` (701) via `isReviewRequiredEnvelope(envelope, role, {kinds:
  reviewKindsFromEnv()})`; does NOT touch `lastReviewedSeq`. v3.6.2 `lastListenerEpoch` fence
  at 660-687 (intact).
- `hooks/mailbox.js:925-949` — `readInboxHistorySince(name,crew,cwd,sinceSeq,limit)`: returns
  rows with `seq > sinceSeq`. Once `lastReviewedSeq == 501`, seq-501 is excluded.
- `hooks/stop.js:1481-1524` — proactive batch producer: envelope with top-level `kind:
  latestTerminal.kind` (e.g. `done`) + `payload.entries[]` + `message` whose body block already
  concatenates the per-report bodies (1510-1519); `appendSystemMailbox(createdByLead, ...,
  {kind:'proactive-report'})`. Top-level `kind` survives onto the persisted envelope
  (`mailbox.js:563` `envKind = envelope.kind || opts.kind`), so the row is review-required.
- `hooks/protocol/review-required.js:1-16,50-65` — `DEFAULT_REVIEW_KINDS` (`done|question|blocked`
  + operator kinds + `member-crashed`); the SAME `isReviewRequiredEnvelope`/`filterReviewRequired`
  is used by both `consumeMailbox` (stamp) and `review-mail` (filter), so they agree today.
- `hooks/actors.js:1180-1212` — `markReviewed`: monotonic `lastReviewedSeq` write
  (`Math.max(current, new)`). Only callers: `/wake` and the `review-mail` handler.
- `lib/listener-loop.js:444-487` — `deliver()`: `consumeMailbox(..., 'listener'/'watch', ...)`,
  emits metadata-only `{type:"messages", count, kinds, actionableCount}` (no bodies, v3.19.0).
  Does NOT advance `lastReviewedSeq`.

### Technical Constraints
- The bug manifests on cursor-advancing paths that don't expand (`/wake`, `--since`, recovery
  branch), NOT on the metadata-only listener path.
- Any path that advances `lastReviewedSeq` to a delivered review-required proactive terminal
  seq MUST first surface that row as an expanded, structurally-reviewable entry.
- Multi-model corroboration: two independent Phase-2 investigations (Codex + Copilot)
  converged on the `/wake` consume-and-advance-without-expand parity gap and recommended
  sharing `expandReviewRows`.

## Approach

### Architecture
1. **Reproduce + instrument first (US-001).** Write failing test(s) that reproduce the seq-501
   empty-`review-mail` symptom on current main, exercising each candidate advancer (`/wake`,
   `review-mail --since`, recovery branch) and capturing, for the failing sequence: the history
   row `via`; `lastReviewRequiredSeq` before/after consume; `lastReviewedSeq` before/after each
   `/wake`/`review-mail`; and which branch advanced the cursor. Produce a 1-page findings note
   (`reproduction-findings.md`) pinning the path(s) that fire. This de-risks the fix and is the
   regression guard's spec.
2. **Share `expandReviewRows`.** Extract the pure helper to `lib/expand-review-rows.js` (sibling
   to `lib/collapse-review-rows.js`); `review-mail.js` imports it (behavior byte-identical).
   The helper must stay pure (no `require` of `config`/`mailbox`/`review-mail`) to avoid the
   `user-prompt-submit.js → review-mail.js → mailbox.js` cycle.
3. **Fix `/wake` to expand before format AND before advance.** In `user-prompt-submit.js`,
   `flatMap` the history rows through the shared `expandReviewRows` (mirroring review-mail.js:239)
   before `formatReviewMailEntry`, so `/wake`'s delivered `entries` are the per-report expanded
   rows incl. the `done`. `markReviewed(lastReviewRequiredSeq)` is then justified. Keep the
   `reviewOverviewEnabled()` `{overview, entries}` vs bare-array body selection intact — only
   `entries` content becomes expanded. Keep the `wake-explicit-only` gate intact (non-`/wake`
   prompts must not consume/advance).
4. **Defense-in-depth on the recovery branch (review-mail.js:274-291).** Scope the silent
   auto-advance NARROWLY so it cannot skip a delivered protocol-v2 proactive **terminal** row:
   before advancing, re-scan the unfiltered history window for a row with `payload.proactive ===
   true` (or `payload.entries[]` present) whose top-level `kind` ∈ `{done,question,blocked}` and
   `seq > lastReviewedSeq`; if one exists, surface it (expand + return as `entries`, advance only
   to that row) instead of silently advancing to `lastReviewRequiredSeq`. Preserve the genuine
   stuck-cursor recovery (pre-v1.3.3 duplicate-seq / intentionally narrowed `CREWS_REVIEW_KINDS`)
   for non-proactive-terminal cases.
5. **`review-mail --since` decision.** `--since N` advancing `reviewedSeq` to `max(allRows.seq)`
   while displaying only `seq > N` is **intended explicit operator skip** — do NOT change its
   advance semantics. US-001 checks the incident for `--since` usage; the plan documents this as
   explicit-skip (the `tests/review-mail-command.test.js:188-191` invariant stays). If US-001
   finds the incident used `--since`, re-scope per its findings.

### Implementation Strategy (ordered, serial)
1. US-001 — reproduce + instrument; failing tests + findings note (pins the path).
2. US-002 — share `expandReviewRows`; fix `/wake` expand-before-advance; recovery-branch guard;
   make the US-001 reproductions pass; review-mail byte-identical regression preserved.
3. US-003 — version bump (6 files) + CHANGELOG + plugin `AGENTS.md` + marketplace/codex-policy
   validation.

- **Create** `<plan/impl job dir>/reproduction-findings.md` — pins the advancer path (US-001).

- **Modify** `hooks/commands/review-mail.js` — import shared `expandReviewRows`; recovery-branch

- **Modify** `hooks/user-prompt-submit.js` — `/wake` expands before `formatReviewMailEntry` and

- **Modify** `tests/wake-explicit-only.test.js` / `tests/stop-member-wake.test.js` /

## Scope

### In Scope
- Reproduce + instrument the seq-501 symptom and pin the over-advance path(s).
- Share `expandReviewRows`; fix `/wake` expand-before-advance; recovery-branch proactive-terminal
  guard.
- A regression test reproducing the seq-501 silent-miss.
- Submodule-internal version bump (6 files), CHANGELOG, and plugin `AGENTS.md`.

### Out of Scope
- Changing the metadata-only listener `deliver()` contract (must NOT carry bodies — avoids the
  v3.6.2 double-notify class).
- Changing `review-mail --since` advance semantics (intended explicit operator skip), unless
  US-001 finds the incident hinged on it.
- The v3.19.0 review-mail overview / buried-but-present `actionableCount` feature (already shipped).
- The v3.6.2 `lastListenerEpoch` fence, protocol-v2 multi-row outbox, v3.6.3 collapse, body-canonical.
- Codexu-side gitlink pointer bump + codexu `AGENTS.md` active-plugin-versions table +
  toolkit-root marketplace pushes — **lead-owned** (two-commit submodule flow, 3-remote push).

## Risk Areas
- **Wrong path pinned / over-claiming `/wake`.** The armed-listener path is provably not the
  silent-advancer. US-001 reproduces BEFORE fixing; the fix closes all confirmed paths so the
  incident is repaired regardless.
- **`/wake` output-shape change.** `entries` becomes expanded per-report rows — an observable
  contract change. Tests must assert expanded **structure** (entry count, per-entry `kind`,
  `outboxSeq`/`reportId`, shared `inboxSeq`, cursor == parent inbox seq), not just body text
  (the batch `message` already contains the body, so a body-text-only assertion is a false pass).
  Update `tests/wake-explicit-only.test.js` / `tests/stop-member-wake.test.js`.
- **Recovery-branch guard regressing genuine stuck-cursor recovery.** Scope the guard to
  protocol-v2 proactive terminal batches only; keep pre-v1.3.3 duplicate-seq / narrowed-env
  recovery working.
- **Two-predicate consistency.** `consumeMailbox` stamp and `review-mail` filter must keep using
  the same `isReviewRequiredEnvelope`.
- **Circular require.** Keep `lib/expand-review-rows.js` pure — no `require` of `config`/`mailbox`/
  `review-mail`.
- **Windows test runner.** Prepend Git Bash to PATH; clear inherited `CREWS_*`/agent-session env
  before `node tests/run.js`; save output to a file (one baseline before, one after).

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1 (US-001): A reproduction test FAILS on current main, demonstrating the seq-501 empty-
  `review-mail` symptom, and a `reproduction-findings.md` names which advancer fired (`/wake`
  markReviewed / `review-mail --since` / recovery branch) with captured `via` +
  `lastReviewRequiredSeq`/`lastReviewedSeq` before/after.
- AC2 (US-002, `/wake` path): `/wake` on a proactive batch (`payload.entries[]` with a trailing
  `done`) returns **expanded per-report entries** including the `done` (assert entry count,
  per-entry `kind`, `outboxSeq`/`reportId`, shared `inboxSeq`), and advances `lastReviewedSeq`
  only after surfacing them. Because `/wake` itself surfaces the done, a subsequent `review-mail`
  is **correctly empty** — assert that explicitly (this is NOT the bug).
- AC3 (US-002, listener path): listener `deliver()` consumes the proactive batch (does NOT advance
  `lastReviewedSeq`); the FIRST subsequent `review-mail` surfaces the expanded `done`
  (`entries` non-empty, `advanced:true`, cursor → the batch inbox seq). FAILS-then-PASSES guard
  for any future regression of this path.
- AC4 (US-002, recovery branch): the legacy-cursor recovery branch does NOT silently advance
  `lastReviewedSeq` past a delivered review-required protocol-v2 proactive **terminal** row — a
  test pins this; AND the genuine stuck-cursor recovery (no proactive-terminal row present) still
  advances as before.
- AC5 (invariants): the metadata-only listener `{type:"messages"}` envelope is unchanged (no
  bodies); the `wake-explicit-only` gate holds (non-`/wake` prompts don't consume/advance); the
  `{overview, entries}` vs bare-array `/wake` body shape is preserved under
  `CREWS_REVIEW_MAIL_OVERVIEW` on AND off; `review-mail --since` advance semantics unchanged
  (`tests/review-mail-command.test.js:188-191` still green); v3.6.2 epoch-fence +
  `proactive-report-silent-loss-race` tests still pass.
- AC6: `node plugins/crews/tests/run.js` green on Windows at default concurrency (save output to a
  file; baseline before + verification after). `node --check` passes on every modified `.js` file.
- AC7 (US-003): version bumped via `scripts/bump-version.js <x.y.z>` (6 stamps + `tests/version.test.js`
  consistent); `CHANGELOG.md` `## <x.y.z>` entry; plugin `AGENTS.md` `## v<x.y.z>` section
  documenting the regression, the pinned path (the `af07987d` protocol-v2 expand parity gap +
  the cursor-over-advance family), the fix, and the "don't make the listener carry content"
  gotcha; `node tools/validate-codex-marketplace-policy.mjs` passes for all three marketplace
  indexes.

## Preliminary Story Decomposition

- **US-001 — Reproduce + instrument the seq-501 silent-miss; pin the over-advance path.**
  Failing reproduction test(s) across `/wake`, `review-mail --since`, and the recovery branch;
  `reproduction-findings.md` pinning the fired path with captured cursor state (AC1).
- **US-002 — Share `expandReviewRows`; fix the cursor-advance-without-expanded-surface paths.**
  Extract to `lib/expand-review-rows.js`; `/wake` expand-before-advance; recovery-branch
  proactive-terminal guard; make the US-001 reproductions pass; preserve review-mail
  byte-identical behavior + the listener/`--since`/wake-gate/overview invariants (AC2-AC6).
  Depends on US-001.
- **US-003 — Version bump + CHANGELOG + plugin AGENTS.md + marketplace/codex-policy validation
  (AC7).** Depends on US-002.

## Suggested Decomposition

All three stories edit the same crews plugin and build on each other (US-002 needs US-001's
pinned path; US-003 stamps version/docs that any parallel story would also touch), so they MUST
run **serially** in one cluster.

### Cluster: crews-proactive-done-silent-miss
- Stories: US-001, US-002, US-003
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`hooks/commands/review-mail.js`, `hooks/user-prompt-submit.js`,
  `lib/expand-review-rows.js`, `tests/integration/proactive-done-silent-miss.test.js`,
  `CHANGELOG.md`, `AGENTS.md`, the 6 version-stamp files]; exclusive=[]; risk=high
- `execution_mode` rationale: Serial only. Reproduce-first (US-001) gates the fix (US-002), which
  gates the version/docs stamp (US-003); all share `review-mail.js`/version/docs surfaces. One
  impl member, one branch, in story order.

  expanded, an observable contract change on that surface (consistent with v3.19.0 overview /
  v3.10.0 tag-aware minor bumps). **3.19.1** (patch) is the conservative alternative if the lead
  deems the `/wake` shape change internal (v3.6.2/v3.14.1 hot-regression precedent was patch).
  Impl uses `scripts/bump-version.js <x.y.z>`; lead confirms.
